# Listing copy — LS-PR-TECH

## Teachers Pay Teachers — title
Matura Extended: Science and technology — 180 terms for LingoSpark games | Paste into vocab games (Bomb, Flashcards, Live Quiz)

## TPT — description (EN)
Extended-level Matura Science and technology vocabulary: research, ICT, space, AI and digital risks. ENG–PL flashcards for LingoSpark games.

This pack is built for Polish exam English (Polish Matura (extended level), B2, topic: Science and technology).

**180 exam-style terms** in 9 lesson sets of about 20 (one 45-minute lesson per set).

Each term has:
- a Polish gloss (paste into games so students type the English word)
- an English definition (harder mode / Matura-style)
- a natural example sentence (used in the gap-fill)

**How it works with LingoSpark (free vocab games):**
1. Copy a paste file (term = definition).
2. Open https://lingospark.study → Vocab Review.
3. Paste into Bomb Defusal, Classic Flashcards, Grid Territory, Vocab Auction, Live Vocab Quiz.
4. Play. No extra software.

Printable worksheets (matching, gap-fill, mini-quiz) plus a full answer key are included as HTML — print to PDF from your browser (Ctrl+P → Save as PDF).

Vocab games on LingoSpark stay free. You do not need a paid Writing Suite account to use this pack.

**Not included:** the site’s free “Człowiek” demo lists. This is original Science and technology content.

Licence: one teacher, one classroom. Do not post the paste files on a public drive.

Suggested price: USD 4

## Polish teacher groups / Facebook
Matura PR: Nauka i technika — 180 haseł do gier LingoSpark

Dział Nauka i technika na maturę rozszerzoną: badania naukowe, ICT, kosmos, sztuczna inteligencja i zagrożenia cyfrowe. Fiszki ENG–PL.

180 haseł (B2), 9 lekcji. Wklejasz do darmowych gier na https://lingospark.study (bomba, fiszki, aukcja, live quiz). Karty do druku + klucz.

Cena sugerowana: 16 zł (plik ZIP).

Licencja: jedna osoba / jedna klasa. Nie wrzucaj plików na Librus „dla całej szkoły” ani na grupę FB.
